tasks.goal: Implement Supervisor v0 RunManifest types and an atomic JSON store for single-repository runs. Provide create/load/save/update, active run pointer, contracts file hash, exclusive supervisor lock with owner metadata, and stale/interrupted detection. Do not change scheduler behavior yet. Add focused tests for atomic writes, hash mismatch, active run lookup, and exclusive lock behavior.

Refactor worker-batch execution to accept an optional RunManifest checkpoint and persist state after every accepted task. On resume, reject changed contracts/base data, use the recorded integration branch, skip accepted tasks, and rebuild pending/ready work from the contract DAG. Preserve existing non-resume behavior. Add a test that simulates a finished first wave and a new scheduler invocation resuming only the remaining wave.
nonGoals: No automatic merge to user main

tasks.goal: Add cliyard supervisor start/status/resume/stop commands using the new manifest store and resumable batch path. Start is foreground for V0. Status must show runId, status, accepted/pending counts, integration branch/head, lock owner and last checkpoint. Add CLI tests using fixture repos and assert a resumed run only starts unfinished tasks.

Document the implemented Supervisor v0 commands, RunManifest, lock/recovery semantics, limitations, and the safe tool self-hosting procedure. Update README and the next-iteration status without claiming daemon or SQLite support.
